scripts.build-sea: npm run build && npx esbuild dist/src/main.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=dist/catnip-sea.cjs && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=process.execPath; const o='catnip.exe'; fs.copyFileSync(p, o); console.log('Copied node to '+o+' ('+fs.statSync(o).size+' bytes)');" && npx postject catnip.exe NODE_SEA_BLOB dist/sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2 && echo SEA build complete: catnip.exe
